description:
CookNest is where people keep the recipes they cook: imported from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and any website, scanned from paper, or typed in. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own CookNest account so you can work with that library in conversation.

Ask what you can cook with chicken and ChatGPT searches your saved recipes, not the web. Paste a link to a recipe you liked and it is saved to your library with ingredients and steps. Plan the week's dinners from your own recipes, then turn the plan into a shopping list sorted by aisle, skipping the staples you always have at home. Tick items off as you shop, keep private notes on a recipe ("less sugar next time"), and organise recipes into collections.

Everything ChatGPT changes shows up right away in the CookNest app on iPhone, Android and the web. You sign in with your CookNest account (Google, Apple or email). ChatGPT only reaches your own recipes, plans and lists; it never receives your password or payment details, and you can disconnect it at any time.

defaultPrompt: What can I cook tonight with the chicken in my fridge?
Plan dinners for this week using my recipes, nothing too long on weekdays.
Add everything I need for my planned meals this week to my shopping list.
